MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The two-pack of outdoor waterproof tape felt useful because my recent outdoor deck screws suggest work where weather-resistant repair supplies could help.",
    "The recommendations recognized the home-project theme in my nails, anchors, and wood screws, although only the outdoor tape matched a need I could reasonably act on now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Steel-reinforced epoxy, locking nuts, and metal-cutting wheels involve different tasks from fastening wood or mounting things in drywall; being workshop supplies does not make them useful for my current work.",
    "Eighteen rolls of tape, ten glue containers, and six adhesive cartridges require a clearer need than I currently have. Even a related supply feels wrong when the quantity exceeds its likely use.",
    "The caliper suggests precision measurement, but my recent purchases give me no immediate reason to need that tool."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The list treated interest in construction fasteners as interest in almost any repair tool or adhesive.",
    "It seemed to assume that buying large packs of nails and screws means I also want bulk quantities of unrelated supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The repeated nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors point toward specific fastening jobs, where material, dimensions, and compatibility matter more than a broad connection to home repairs.",
    "My outdoor screws make weather resistance relevant, which helped the outdoor tape feel appropriate, but they do not establish a need for metal repair or cutting equipment.",
    "Quantity depends on the task: I can use many fasteners in one project without needing many containers of glue or rolls of tape."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The list recognized my home-project interests but stretched them into unrelated repair tasks and bulk supplies without enough evidence of an immediate need."
}
